stories.title: Frontier AI competition accelerates
stories.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra launch is pushing frontier-model competition further toward agents, coding and software workflows, alongside rapid releases from rivals.
stories.meaning: More capable agents can increase inference, tool calls and workflow automation, potentially expanding cloud consumption even as the cost of individual model calls falls.

stories.title: Gulf tensions keep energy risk central
stories.summary: Iran's leverage around the Strait of Hormuz remains an important energy-market variable even as the market has adapted to some disruption risk.
stories.meaning: A renewed oil shock could lift inflation expectations, push yields higher and weigh on rate-sensitive equities and crypto.

stories.title: Markets balance growth against tighter-policy risk
stories.summary: Global markets are balancing resilient growth with inflation and rate-hike concerns as oil remains elevated and risk assets continue to move higher.
stories.meaning: A hawkish rates repricing can pressure long-duration equities and crypto even when economic growth remains solid.

stories.title: TikTok turns comments into richer engagement surfaces
stories.summary: TikTok is adding voice comments, comment polls, photo carousels and Live Photo comments, making the comment section a more interactive content surface.
stories.meaning: Creators increasingly need to design for participation and downstream conversation, not only the initial video view. Comment strategy can become part of distribution strategy.
